ns2:section.sectionText: Please note the stated prerequisites. The registration system may allow you to select this course even if you do not meet the prerequisites; however, you will be removed from the course if you have not met them. You must simultaneously register for both the 'BL1' Lecture AND a 'B' Lab to complete registration for this course. Please note: This section will have synchronous (live) sessions, to be held during the scheduled class day/time listed in Course Explorer.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Senior, Sophomore, or Junior class standing.
